research_lineage: Risk-only repair defined after S98 produced positive and broadly robust historical PnL but missed its frozen 15% drawdown ceiling by 0.25 percentage point. S99 does not claim new alpha and all history is contaminated development.
signal: Exactly S98: own close above SMA200, positive 84-day return, top-three return/vol rank, 28-day mean-funding veto above +0.0001.
portfolio_change_from_s98: Annual volatility target is reduced from 20% to 15%; every other signal, concentration, execution and cost rule is unchanged.

data.source: checksum-verified public Binance USD-M monthly 1d and fundingRate archives

robustness.risk_target_neighbors: 12.5% and 17.5% must each be profitable under stress and remain at or below 15% drawdown
robustness.leave_one_symbol_out: at least five of six stress replays profitable
robustness.bootstrap: 5000 deterministic circular 28-day blocks; 10th percentile terminal PnL must be positive
robustness.continuous_ledger: one replay without resets across report slices

historical_gate.full_stress: net PnL > 0, Sharpe >= 0.50, max drawdown <= 15%, positive-month share >= 45%
historical_gate.time_dispersion: all three stress slices non-negative, at least two positive, largest positive month <= 60% of total positive monthly PnL
historical_gate.promotion: historical pass means paper-forward challenger only for at least 26 decisions and 180 days; live remains disabled

disclosures: S99 was selected after inspecting S98 and is therefore a candidate risk budget, not independent validation.
No post-result adjustment is permitted after this protocol is hashed.
Daily funding uses same-day close as mark proxy; intraday liquidation, outages, latency and taxes are not modelled.
